name: WPA Institute Cognitive Operating Principle
core_rule_mk: WPA НЕ ГО ПРЕЗЕМА ТУЃОТО ЗНАЕЊЕ. WPA ГО ПРОВЕРУВА, ГО РАЗЛОЖУВА, ГО СООЧУВА СО СОПСТВЕНАТА ДОКТРИНА, ГО МЕРИ, ГО ПРЕИСПИТУВА И ОД НЕГО СОЗДАВА НОВА WPA ИНСТИТУЦИОНАЛНА ВРЕДНОСТ.
core_rule_en: WPA does not appropriate external knowledge. WPA verifies it, decomposes it, tests it against its own doctrine and methodology, measures and challenges it, and from that process creates new WPA institutional value.

COLLECT.rule: Collect public-source signals, open scholarly metadata, legally reusable book material and public institutional portal evidence with provenance. Collection alone confers no authority or truth status.

RIGHTS_SOURCE_CHECK.rule: Before substantive transformation, verify source identity, public/open access basis, licence/reuse basis where applicable, traceability, robots/access boundaries for institutional portals, and absence of protected-body retention. Metadata-only material remains discovery-only.

WPA_NATIVE_TRANSFORM.rule: Convert eligible evidence into a new WPA analytical layer through HGAIM, Doctrine Kernel, Institutional DNA, Protocolometry, strategic leverage, capability-resilience, Virtual Sande and Viral Sande lenses. Preserve attribution and prohibit copy-paste substitution.

CHECK.rule: Validate relevance, traceability, methodological measurability, contradictions, editorial classification, Sublimate/Pilot evidence packages and institutional verification candidates without making scientific, canonical or official judgments.

PRODUCE.rule: Produce bounded WPA work products, dossiers, digests, research and programme candidates. Journal Watch remains editorial intelligence and cannot automatically generate, accept, peer-review or publish a scientific article.

ADAPT.rule: Create platform-native and use-case-native versions for WPA systems, Virtual Sande, Viral Sande, social networks and authorised messenger/community channels while preserving one factual core and provenance.

HUMAN_APPROVAL.rule: Production merge, external publication, canonical change, scientific publication, peer-review decision, methodology freeze, institutional commitment and official judgment remain under the applicable Human Gate.

non_negotiable_boundaries: No paywall, login, CAPTCHA or access-control bypass.
No protected full-text copying merely because material is discoverable or viewable.
No removal or obscuring of source authorship and provenance.
No autonomous doctrine mutation or canonical revision.
No automatic scientific publication, editorial acceptance or peer-review decision.
No automatic ordinal institutional ranking from discovery or portal presence.
No automatic external social/messenger publication or unsolicited mass messaging.
No claim of partnership, affiliation, accreditation, endorsement or world-first originality without independent evidence and the applicable Human Gate.
